parts.text: Fix her hands. Her right fist grips the spear shaft, knuckles to the viewer, exactly as now. Remove the loose rusty hook lying near the spear at the bottom. Her LEFT arm (the arm on the far side, toward the left of the image) now ends in a rusty prosthetic hook hand: a leather-strapped cuff on the forearm with a curved rusty iron hook, raised in front of her chest at the left, clearly attached to her left wrist. No extra hands. Keep everything else identical: rusted hockey half-mask, grey bun, black jumpsuit, saw weed whacker on her back, blood splatter backdrop, pose, clay style. No text.
